title: ruellia caroliniensis subsp. ciliosa
intro: Ruellia caroliniensis subsp. ciliosa, commonly known as Carolina Wild Petunia, is a flowering plant species native to the southeastern United States. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Ruellia caroliniensis subsp. ciliosa include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, respiratory issues, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as analgesia, antispasmodic, and antioxidant effects.
